reuse.why: Uses the shared EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the existing mutator(undoable(...)) registration, so the exclusion rule comes from the same definition as the sibling actions.

duplication.why: The category query and the income/tracking guard are copied from the sibling actions (a pattern already pasted in four places), and the expense sign flip is written again inline.

placement.why: The action sits with the other month-wide actions in server/budget/actions.ts and is registered next to them in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Easy to read and consistent with its siblings; it inherits rule changes to EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER but still adds one more copy of the query/income-guard skeleton.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new action filters categories through EDITABLE_CATEGORY_FILTER like the existing ones.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query and income guard are verbatim, not reshaped.
